title: Inviting Log Home Estate in Maple Valley, Washington
description:
Presented by Brazen Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to: http://ow.ly/PEzFs

A custom built, post and beam, log home estate built in the style of Frank Loyd Wright, anchored on five acres. Bronze-glazed windows cast a vast warm light, on custom Brazilian Cumaru flooring. The captivating grandeur of the inlaid, custom totem art above the fireplace evokes conversation. The three-story lava rock fireplace invites warmth. French accordion doors open from the 800 square foot dining room, to a 2,000 square foot ironwood deck, offering 180 degree views of the valley below.

Property ID: L6TRD6
